tool_internal_and_mounted.checked: Revision-39 P18 and its bushings and magnets against the rest of each tool and every mounted carriage part (revision-37 carriage).

frame_source.note: Nominal frame, panels and door from 01_Voron24_350_Frame_and_Enclosure as world bounding boxes (conservative for the extrusion profiles). No Z drives, bed supports or bed wiring are modeled.

hardware.per_tool: P18: 2x 5x7x5.5 mm bushings pressed flush into the bar (was 2x Ø5x12 mm dowel pins); 2x Ø6x4 mm N52 magnets unchanged.
hardware.per_dock: P25: 2x Ø5x12 mm rounded dowel pins pressed 6.5 mm in, 5.5 mm proud (was 2x 5x7x5.5 mm bushings); 2x Ø6x4 mm N52 magnets unchanged.
hardware.totals_for_ten_tools_and_docks: 20 dowel pins, 20 bushings, 40 magnets: the same as before.

limitations: Rigid CAD and sampled straight paths. Press fits, bushing retention, magnet pull and pin wear are not qualified; the fits copy the released seats (bushing seat Ø7.04, pin bore Ø4.98).
The dock pins stand 5.5 mm proud of an empty dock; nothing in the audited paths reaches them, but keep hands and wiring clear when servicing the rack.
Both hotends use the same P18; the Red Lizard's released P18 snapshot (0.1 mm3 different) is replaced by it.
World CAD coordinates; commission the slicer front limit on the machine.
